messages:
lina_acct: HelioTherm says procurement needs an explicit BYOK + escrow clarification before countersigning the OF. also asking for a short-term SLA bump for demo days and a 50/50 activation invoicing split. can legal confirm acceptable language?
margo_legal: need the exact wording from them. BYOK + escrow are very different asks which one are they insisting on?
ryan_se: Tech note: They require a clause that we won\u2019t use their PII to tune models during the POC, plus a dedicated endpoint with isolated logs. Should we offer an ingest token with retention rules?
infra_bot: env-provision: heliotherm-poc-sandbox created. Dedicated logging bucket: gs://heliotherm-poc-logs (retention 30d).
diego_billing: net45 ok. Activation + demo-burst as separate line items recommended. Need PO and bill-to entity. also ask about tax jurisdiction on activation charge.
margo_legal: BYOK: we can support customer-managed keys but we refuse to hold escrowed keys. propose: "Support for customer-provided keys per Redwood KMS Onboarding Guide. Redwood will not export or escrow customer keys." that should remove escrow requirement.
margo_legal: SLA: We can provide a POC SLO for scheduled demo windows (max 72 hrs cumulative) at 99.5% availability, with exclusions for force majeure and customer-caused load tests. we need rollback language to protect prod.
ryan_se: demo schedule is 05/12 10:00-16:00 UTC. Ops, can you reserve burst capacity?
infra_bot: capacity-check: sandbox mapped to 2xA100 reserved. burst for 6 hours estimated incremental cost $380. reserve pending PO confirmation.
diego_billing: I'll draft an OF with activation 50% due upfront and remainder after POC. Putting the burst cost as a separate line so procurement can approve. Draft INV-HT-0512 created.
elain_pm: quick ask  what approver names do we need on the PO to speed routing?
lina_acct: HelioTherm Procurement contact: procurement@heliotherm.com and approver: Sara Lind (VP Ops).
margo_legal: I'll generate a 1-page addendum with the BYOK clause + POC SLO + data usage no-train clause. Will reference our SOC2 + DPA exhibits and link onboarding steps. Target EOD.
ryan_se: For the ingest token and retention rules, I'll prepare the onboarding checklist to send to the client (keys metadata + CSR + thumbprint).
infra_bot: doc-routing: when final OF uploaded, tag as `helio-therm-poc-of` to trigger Sales->Legal->Finance route.
diego_billing: sending estimate and PO instructions to client now, cc'ing finance for tax.
lina_acct: Will follow up with Sara for PO turnaround. client said they need signed OF by 05/08 to keep demo slot.
margo_legal: draft uploaded: https://legal.redwood/drafts/helio_therm_poc_addendum_v1. please review.
elain_pm: no blockers from PM. coordinate demos with sales calendar.
lina_acct: Thanks team. i'll post client responses here. :thumbsup:
